disclaimer: BetterBill is informational, not legal or medical advice.
estimateNote: Savings are estimates. Results depend on the hospital.
syntheticNote: This is a synthetic sample bill. The hospital price comparison uses real public data.

duplicate.title: Listed twice on the same day
duplicate.explanation: This charge appears twice with the same date and amount. Ask the hospital to confirm you had it twice.

units.title: More units than usual
units.explanation: You were billed {units} units. Medicare's usual daily limit for this code is {mue} (CMS, {effective}).

eob_mismatch.title: Bill doesn't match your insurer
eob_mismatch.explanation: Your insurer says you owe {eob}. The hospital is asking for {due}.

published_price.title: Higher than the hospital's own cash price
published_price.explanation: The hospital's published cash price is {cash}. You were billed {billed}.

missing_itemization.title: Ask for an itemized bill
missing_itemization.explanation: This statement doesn't list each service. You can ask for an itemized bill.

assistance.title: You may qualify for help paying
assistance.explanation: The hospital's policy says: "{quote}". This is an estimate, not a decision.

letterRules: Every claim maps to a flag id.
Quote the evidence and its source.
Ask for a corrected itemized bill and a hold on collections while the bill is under review. Phrase both as requests.
Show the disclaimer in the app only, not in the letter body.
No medical details beyond codes and dates.

callLines.opening: Hi, this is an automated assistant calling on behalf of a patient.
callLines.purpose: I'm calling about two items on an account ending in {last4}.
callLines.ask: Could you review these and tell me the next step?
callLines.close: Thank you. Can I get a reference number for this call?

facts.text: Close to half (45%) of insured adults ages 19 to 64 got a medical bill in the past year they thought insurance should have covered.
facts.footnote: Commonwealth Fund Health Care Affordability Survey 2023 (n = 5,602 insured adults 19 to 64), published Aug 1, 2024.

facts.text: Fewer than half pushed back, mostly because they didn't know they could.
facts.footnote: Commonwealth Fund Health Care Affordability Survey 2023, published Aug 1, 2024.

facts.text: When people disputed, 38% saw the bill reduced or eliminated.
facts.footnote: Commonwealth Fund Health Care Affordability Survey 2023, published Aug 1, 2024.

facts.text: Goodbill charges 20% of savings, capped at $1,000 (its help center, Oct 2026).
Goodbill handles unpaid hospital bills with human experts.

facts.note: 48 states and DC: 1 person $15,960; each additional person adds $5,680. Full table in data/hospitals/fpl-2026.json (C-06).

facts.text: LA County's program says care is free at or under 200% of the poverty level (its website, captured {capturedAt}).
facts.note: {capturedAt} is filled from the C-06 capture. Policy PDF details are unverified; cite the web page only.
